name: Alien Defense : Shooting Game
summary:
Prepare for an intense VR alien invasion!

Step into the battlefield and fight against waves of deadly aliens in an action-packed VR shooting experience. Defend your position, clear dangerous rooms, unlock powerful weapons, and see how long you can survive.

🔥 SURVIVE ALIEN WAVES
Face increasingly challenging waves of aliens. Every wave brings a new challenge, so stay alert and keep your weapons ready.
